nodes.description: Hero Talent

nodes.name: Unstable Factory
nodes.description: BLASTOLOGY: Your spell cast has a chance to make your next Nano-bot-factory unstable, instead of creating healing nano-bot, it will generate explsive goblin-sapper that will chase the closest enemy dealing (500% sp)damage

nodes.name: Quicker
nodes.description: Goblin sapper are depolied quicker

nodes.name: Safe
nodes.description: Goblin sapper explosion count as a super-safe-box

nodes.name: Faster
nodes.description: Goblin Sapper are faster

nodes.name: Intellectual
nodes.description: Goblin-sapper explosion increase your intellect by 1% for 5 seconds

nodes.name: Hastened
nodes.description: Whle unstable factory is active, increase movement speed by 5% to all friendly creature

nodes.name: Genial
nodes.description: Goblin Sapper explosion reduce the cd of Flash of genius by 0.5s

nodes.name: Bigger
nodes.description: Goblin sapper explosion is doubled

nodes.name: Masterfull
nodes.description: While a goblin sapper is alive, increase mastery by 5%

nodes.name: Helpfull
nodes.description: Whenever a goblin-sapper is deployed, decrease a movement-speed cd by 0.5s

nodes.name: Resourcefull
nodes.description: Goblin sapper explosion may grant you 1 gadget

nodes.name: Smarter
nodes.description: Goblin sapper chase the lowest % enemy

nodes.name: Versatile
nodes.description: Every 5 explosions, gain 1% versatility for 30 second

nodes.name: Deploy Factory
nodes.description: Deploy an Unstable Factory

nodes.name: Chrono Flame
nodes.description: Replace Living Flame with a time-infused version that adds damage or healing related to the target's recent damage or healing.

nodes.name: Warp
nodes.description: Hover warps you through space and provides additional protection during the movement.

nodes.name: Temporal Burst
nodes.description: Tip the Scales grants a burst of haste, movement and cooldown recovery that fades over time.

nodes.name: Reverberations
nodes.description: Improve the time-based follow-up damage of your Augmentation abilities.

nodes.name: Temporality
nodes.description: Temporal Burst also provides a defensive benefit.

nodes.name: Motes of Acceleration
nodes.description: Warp creates acceleration motes that help allies move faster.

nodes.name: Threads of Fate
nodes.description: Empowered spells can create temporal threads that echo supported allies' output.

nodes.name: Primacy
nodes.description: Improve your haste through the use of empowered spells.

nodes.name: Double-time
nodes.description: Chrono Flame's temporal damage and healing can repeat.

nodes.name: Time Convergence
nodes.description: Improve the benefit provided by your time-based stat effects.

nodes.name: Instability Matrix
nodes.description: Empowered spells can reduce the cooldown of an empowered spell.

nodes.name: Golden Opportunity
nodes.description: Prescience can provide an enhanced support opportunity.

nodes.name: Temporal Compression
nodes.description: Casting non-empowered spells builds a benefit for your next empowered spell.

nodes.name: Akashic Imprint
nodes.description:
Expending Insight creates an Akashic apparition for 15seconds. 
Akashic apparition despair the target of your Crushing Strike increasing it's unvail weakness effect by 2% per apparition

nodes.name: Step Between Symbols
nodes.description: Fade removes movement slows and reduces damage you take by 10% for 3 seconds. It does not teleport you or break roots and stuns.

nodes.name: Moment of Gnosis
nodes.description: Hermetic Focus grants you 15% haste for 8 seconds. If Hermetic Focus is not selected, casting Grand Conjunction grants this benefit instead. The two triggers refresh rather than stack it.

nodes.name: Resonance of the Unspoken
nodes.description: When an Akashic apparition expire it resonate dealing  (100% sp) damage to enemy in range

nodes.name: Shelter Beyond the Veil
nodes.description: While Moment of Gnosis is active, you take 3% less damage per Akashic apparition.

nodes.name: Waymarks of the Unseen
nodes.description: Fade leaves a waymark at your location for 6 seconds. The first party ally to touch it has movement slows removed and becomes immune to slows for 3 seconds. An ally can benefit only once every 10 seconds. Roots and stuns are unaffected.

nodes.name: Threads of Correspondence
nodes.description: Completing Mind Flay extends your existing Occult Diagnosis on that enemy by 1 second, up to 12 seconds remaining, and your existing Communion links by 1 second each, up to their talented base duration plus 15 seconds remaining. No Diagnosis or link is created or revived. Does not increase vulnerability strength or share personal haste.

nodes.name: Primacy of Understanding
nodes.description: Mind Blast grants 2% personal haste for 6 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. A new cast refreshes the shared duration. Echoes and secondary hits grant no stacks.

nodes.name: Twice-Written Fate
nodes.description: Akashic Imprint has a 20% chance to resolve one additional time.

nodes.name: Confluence of Signs
nodes.description: Increase Moment of Gnosis's duration by 2 seconds. If Moment of Gnosis is not selected, a completed Mind Flay channel instead grants you 5% haste for 4 seconds; this fallback does not stack with itself.

nodes.name: Fractured Axiom
nodes.description: Each completed Mind Flay channel has a 15% chance to restore one Mind Blast charge, without exceeding its maximum. Channels interrupted before their final tick do not trigger this effect.

nodes.name: Crushing apparition
nodes.description: Crushing strike as a chance to consume 1 Insight and increase the duration of all Unvail Weakness by 3 seconds

nodes.name: Beyond the veil
nodes.description: Crushing Strike leaves an Akashic apparition when it dashes you.

nodes.name: Fading Apparition
nodes.description: Fade creates an Akashic apparition
